thread:
Sam W: Quick sync — planning to toggle the new burst_throttle (v1.3) on the staging fleet tomorrow for a canary. Thinking 10% traffic for 2h during low-traffic window. Any objections or immediate concerns?

Lee T: can we surface the key metrics to watch? spike in latency or dropped requests? also need a way to throttle back automatically.

Sam W: good call. primary metrics: p95 latency, token/sec, and error_rate (5xx). rollout plan includes auto-rollback on error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. will also watch queue_depth and OOM signals.

Maria S: add SLO alert for p99 > 1.5s too. if we see sustained p99 degradation, rollback immediately. also enable extra log retention for the canary group.

Jordan K: window? I can be oncall during the push. suggest 03:00–05:00 UTC.

Anya P: ML note — the throttle changes the batching behavior; validate that prompt latency distribution doesn't shift tail for long-context jobs. I'll run a quick prompt set against the canary before enabling.

Sam W: thanks. updated plan snippet:
```
feature_flag: burst_throttle_v1.3
scope: service=runtime, models=[all-prod-compatible]
canary: 5% -> ramp 5%->20% over 30m if healthy
guardrails:
  - max_concurrency_per_replica: 250
  - queueing_enabled: true
  - rollback_on_error_rate_pct: 0.5 (5m)
telemetry: enable detailed token-level traces for canary group
maintenance_window: 03:00-05:00 UTC
```

Lee T: switching to 5% initial looks safer than 10%. agree with the guardrails. what's the plan for burst queueing? drop or queue?

Sam W: queueing_enabled=true — we prefer soft degradation via queueing to avoid sudden rejects. we'll surface queue_len and queue_wait_time.

Maria S: pls make sure the alerting runbook has the commands to flip the flag back and to scale up dedicated pool if needed. also add a step to disable telemetry after 24h.

Jordan K: I'll be available at 03:00 UTC. if anything weird, I'll flip to stable. add me to the rollout channel.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: feature-flag rollout for burst_throttle_v1.3 at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z. Runbook: /runbooks/burst-throttle-canary.md

Anya P: I ran the prompt set on staging with the flag toggled for 5% simulated traffic. no regressed outputs, p95 rose ~30ms on long contexts, p99 unchanged. pushing results to the dashboard.

Sam W: decision: roll out canary at 5% with the listed guardrails (max_concurrency 250, queueing on, auto-rollback on errors). Jordan oncall, Maria alerting, Anya checking quality. Ramp to 20% only if all green after 30m.

Lee T: pinging infra to ensure we have reserve capacity to scale if queueing spikes.

Maria S: I'll update the alert routing and add a temporary p99 SLO for the canary cohort.

Sam W: thanks everyone. I'll create the toggle ticket and the short checklist. tagging @Jordan K and @Anya P in the rollout thread. :thumbsup:

Jordan K: :thumbsup: ready.

Anya P: 👍 will monitor quality and post any diffs.

Sam W: closing this thread — follow the rollout channel for live updates.
